public.billing_notes: prompt_tokens includes cached_tokens. Billed as (prompt-cached)*input + cached*cached_input + completion*output. Reasoning tokens are part of completion_tokens.

rate_limits.notes: per_request_limits for this account/model from /v1/models?verbose=true and identical x-ratelimit-limit-* response headers. The rate-limit docs describe dynamic upscaling (+20% per 15-min window at >=80% utilisation, ceiling 20x base) and an Enterprise tier without soft caps.

sources.label: Token Factory /v1/models?verbose=true pricing block (prompt 0.00000015, input_cache_read 0.0000001, completion 0.0000006 USD/token)
Cached tokens are billed at the model's cached input price (Serverless only)
Third-party cross-check: OpenRouter Nebius endpoint lists 0.15 / 0.60 per 1M

dedicated.billing_model: Per GPU-hour, per-minute granularity; billed while >=1 replica is ready; zero replicas = no charge; provisioning/not-ready not billed.
dedicated.price_note: Token Factory does not publish Dedicated Endpoint GPU-hour prices (contract/console-dependent). Defaults below are Nebius AI Cloud on-demand GPU-instance list prices used as a PROXY. They are adjustable in the dashboard. Commitments are advertised up to 35% lower.

sources.label: Nebius AI Cloud on-demand prices (H100 $4.50, H200 $5.40, B200 $8.50 per GPU-hour), checked 2026-10-30
Nebius AI Cloud compute pricing docs (GPU line items $3.85 / $4.50 / $7.15)
Dedicated endpoints overview: per GPU/hour billed with per-minute granularity

batch.note: Batch inference at half the real-time price (24h turnaround) - not suitable for interactive coding agents; shown for context only.
